description: Implementation of the SourceLineResolverBase class for symbol and module management in breakpad, including functions for loading modules, reading symbol files, and resolving source line info.

classes.name: SourceLineResolverBase
classes.description: Manages source line resolution, module loading/unloading, and symbol file reading for breakpad.

classes.name: SourceLineResolverBase::Module
classes.description: Represents a code module with methods for parsing CFIRule sets and other module-specific operations.

methods.name: ReadSymbolFile
methods.description: Reads a symbol file into memory, returning the data and size.

methods.name: LoadModule
methods.description: Loads a module's symbols from a file.

methods.name: LoadModuleUsingMapBuffer
methods.description: Loads a module's symbols from a string buffer.

methods.name: LoadModuleUsingMemoryBuffer
methods.description: Loads a module's symbols from a memory buffer.

methods.name: ShouldDeleteMemoryBufferAfterLoadModule
methods.description: Indicates whether to delete memory buffers after loading modules.

methods.name: UnloadModule
methods.description: Unloads a module and cleans up associated resources.

methods.name: HasModule
methods.description: Checks if a module is loaded.

methods.name: IsModuleCorrupt
methods.description: Checks if a module's symbols are marked as corrupt.

methods.name: FillSourceLineInfo
methods.description: Fills source line info for a given stack frame.

methods.name: FindWindowsFrameInfo
methods.description: Finds Windows-specific frame info for a stack frame.

methods.name: FindCFIFrameInfo
methods.description: Finds CFI frame info for a stack frame.

methods.name: CompareString::operator()
methods.description: String comparison operator for sorting module filenames.

methods.name: Module::ParseCFIRuleSet
methods.description: Parses CFIRule set for a module.
